observations.label: Tarif horaire — confirmé 3–7 ans
observations.includes_material: NO
observations.normalization_note: Hourly rate for mid-level electrician. Casablanca 200–280 DH/h per city data. Useful for artisan economic floor calculation — confirms 30-min intervention should yield 100–140 DH labour value.

observations.label: Dépannage urgence (1h) — afous.ma P30-P70
observations.includes_travel: AMBIGUOUS — hourly rate may be separate from travel
observations.includes_material: NO
observations.normalization_note: Best-quality observation for hourly rate. P30–P70 with 480 relevés. Casablanca reference (coeff 1.00). Monthly stability: mostly 160–170 DH range over 12 months (+1% evolution). KEY INSIGHT: urgency hourly rate 150–180 DH is LOWER than mano.ma stated rate — suggests afous.ma is collecting actual paid prices, not ask prices. Confirms electrician labour market is 150–200 DH/h nationally.

observations.label: Installation prise / interrupteur — afous.ma P30-P70
observations.includes_material: LIKELY_NO — per-unit labour only at 70–80 DH
observations.normalization_note: KEY OBSERVATION: 70–80 DH per unit from 480 relevés. This is LABOUR-ONLY per outlet/switch installation. A prise costs 20–80 DH retail. If this includes part at the low end it implies loss-making. Most likely: labour only, client provides hardware OR hardware included but at basic quality. Cannot make FIXEO fixed price from per-unit rate alone — must combine with travel/call-out fee.

observations.label: Remplacement disjoncteur — afous.ma P30-P70
observations.includes_material: AMBIGUOUS — disjoncteur retail 50–200 DH. At 170–200 DH forfait, labour-only interpretation is possible if part is cheap (simple MCB 50–80 DH); with standard disjoncteur (100–150 DH) this may be labour-only + cheapest part, or full forfait at the low market end
observations.normalization_note: CRITICAL OBSERVATION: 170–200 DH forfait for disjoncteur replacement from 480 relevés. Compare to mano.ma 400–800 DH. Reconciliation: afous.ma likely reflects national average (including lower-cost cities at ×0.85 coefficient), mano.ma may include more expensive urban scenarios. Also afous.ma may be labour-only while mano.ma includes brand-name part. The gap (170 vs 400) is large — likely unit/scope mismatch. Best estimate: simple single MCB replacement, labour + basic part, urban: 200–350 DH.

observations.label: Tarif horaire Casablanca
observations.includes_material: NO
observations.normalization_note: Casablanca-specific hourly rate. Confirms urban premium. 200–280 DH/h for Casa vs 150–180 DH national afous.ma rate. Casablanca coefficient ×1.00 on afous.ma — the afous rate IS Casablanca reference already. Apparent inconsistency: afous.ma 150–180 DH/h vs mano.ma 200–280 DH Casa. Reconciliation: ask vs paid rate gap, or experience level difference.

observations.label: Installation complète — scope factors
observations.normalization_note: Scope context only. Confirms: installation complete includes cable, gaines, raccordement, prises, interrupteurs, tests. Complexity drivers: circuit count, tableau size, encastré vs saillie, appareillage quality, domotique.

observations.label: Urgence — modifiers
observations.normalization_note: Urgency modifiers from mano.ma: soir +30–50%, nuit +50–100%, weekend +40–60%, jours fériés +60–100%. These are EDITORIAL ESTIMATES — not statistically observed. FIXEO must not encode as guaranteed rates. Label: 'indicatif — tarif artisan prévalent'.
